output.reasoning:
Clock offsets, from honest witnesses anchored to the Grand Temple bell (true 10:00 at the strike of ten):
- Rosa's kitchen clock: +15 (she says so, and Lina confirms it is exactly 15 minutes fast).
- Regulator: true at 10:00 (Lina), and it read 10:20 when Lina left the atelier, so Lina left at true 10:20.
- Salon clock: -5 (Dr Vauthier and Madame both read 9:55 at the temple's ten).
- Hall Morbier: +12. Rosa heard it strike eleven at her 11:03, which is true 10:48. Girard saw its face at 11:02 when his watch read 10:46, which is true 10:50. Both fit.
- Félix's watch: -20 (8:40 at nine, 9:40 at ten).
- Girard's watch: -4 (9:56 at ten).

Piano and salon: Dr left the salon at 10:28 by the salon clock, which is true 10:33. Madame's piano ran continuously from 10:33 to 10:46 true (Rosa, Lina, Girard all agree). So Madame was at the keyboard throughout and cannot have been in the atelier. Dr was in the hall, which is possible in principle, but his account is consistent with everyone else's.

Rosa and Lina alibi each other in the kitchen from 10:22 to after 11:00. Each one's alibi is confirmed by the other, and both are honest, so neither was upstairs at 10:38.

Girard was in the street from about 10:25 to 10:50 true. His hearing of the repeater and the piano is consistent with the other clocks, so he is honest.

The blow time: Félix heard a thump at 10:18 by his watch, which is true 10:38, then the repeater's hour and quarter notes. Girard, in the street, heard the repeater's bells at 10:34 by his watch, which is true 10:38. The two independent witnesses agree on 10:38.

The lie: Félix says his uncle came into the library at 10:32 by his watch (true 10:52) and they sat together until eleven. But the uncle was already dead at 10:38, having pressed the repeater as he fell. So Félix's account is impossible, which makes him the only one lying. That fits rule 2: the murderer is the liar and the other five are honest. Félix also had a motive (debts, the uncle's public scolding) and was alone in the library directly beneath the atelier. He heard the thump there. He also has an unexplained trip up the stairs at true 10:35 and back down at 10:41, which is exactly the window around the blow. Girard's claim that he visited Félix in the library around 10:50 is the other thing Félix omitted, which fits the same lie.

The regulator's stop at 10:05 is a false setting by the murderer after Lina left at 10:20, so it does not give the time of the blow.
